buildCommand: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build

rewrites.comment: SPA fallback for client-side routes ONLY. The previous catch-all /(.*) also swallowed /api/*, so when VITE_API_URL was unset the frontend's API calls were answered with index.html and HTTP 200 — axios parsed the HTML as a successful response, every page found no `nodes`/`stats` field on it and rendered empty, and nothing anywhere reported an error. That is the whole reason a Vercel deployment came up with no data. Excluding /api makes a missing backend URL fail loudly as a 404 instead of silently as an empty dataset.
